scope.purpose: evaluate a standalone phase-equivariant spline/CPWL memoryless nonlinearity followed by a short causal complex FIR
scope.model_role: standalone alternative PA model, not an additive correction to GMP

direction.path: x_split -> standalone SPH PA -> y_hat_split -> compare with measured y_split

evidence.usage_status: the family is chosen after inspecting train OOF and validation residuals; validation is descriptive/reused and not independent confirmation

dataset_contract.frame_state_policy: reset at every explicit complete or partial frame
dataset_contract.partial_final_frame_policy: score as a short independent frame
dataset_contract.test_policy: test files must not be opened, hashed, named in output, or used for release; a new capture is required for a new test claim

model.name: phase_equivariant_complex_spline_hammerstein_pa
equations: h_0 = 1 + 0j exactly and is not stored or multiplied
model.identifiability_constraint: fix h_0=1 exactly; spline control points absorb direct complex gain and phase
model.causality: all FIR delays are 0 through L-1; zero lookahead
model.coordinate_clipping: clip only s to the training-fit knot endpoints; do not clip complex x; report every held/validation sample above fit support
model.local_support: exactly two adjacent complex spline control points are active per sample

coordinate_and_knot_variants.name: amplitude_uniform
coordinate_and_knot_variants.knot_rule: K points uniformly spaced from 0 to max_fit(abs(x))

coordinate_and_knot_variants.name: amplitude_uniform_power_placement
coordinate_and_knot_variants.knot_rule: r_k=sqrt(q_k), with q_k uniform from 0 to max_fit(abs(x))^2; interpolation remains linear in amplitude

coordinate_and_knot_variants.name: amplitude_quantile
coordinate_and_knot_variants.knot_rule: amplitude quantiles with endpoints forced to 0 and max_fit(abs(x)); duplicate removal is forbidden to change K silently

coordinate_and_knot_variants.name: power_uniform
coordinate_and_knot_variants.knot_rule: K points uniformly spaced from 0 to max_fit(abs(x)^2); interpolation is linear in power and is a distinct basis

fit.solver: complex augmented least squares via numpy.linalg.lstsq; no normal equations
fit.smoothness_operator: coordinate-aware nonuniform-knot second derivative applied to complex control points
fit.initialization: solve the penalized memoryless spline exactly with h[1:]=0
alternating_block_order: solve FIR tail h[1:] with c fixed and h_0=1
solve spline control points c with FIR fixed
required_diagnostics: unregularized design rank for every solved block
objective before and after every block update
fraction and maximum coordinate above fit support
hard_fit_validity: all coefficients, predictions, singular values and objectives finite
unregularized control design full column rank
unregularized FIR-tail design full column rank when L>1
no objective increase beyond the frozen numerical tolerance
reset-frame and arbitrary-chunk streaming equivalence exact in complex128

staged_search.retention: keep at most two (variant,L) topologies within 0.05 dB full-record OOF NMSE of the stage winner; order ties by common NMSE, fewer nonlinear operations, shorter L, then name
freeze one (variant,L,K) using the common ranking rule
freeze one (control_ridge,smoothness) pair using the common ranking rule
freeze the final model recipe using the common ranking rule

search_budget.candidate_cache: reuse exact duplicate recipe/fold fits by a canonical recipe hash

operation_count_convention.fma: one real multiplication plus one real addition

per_complex_sample_formulas.nonlinear_operations: 1 for amplitude coordinate; 0 for power coordinate

selection.validation_role: load only after final recipe freeze; report as already-viewed descriptive evidence
selection.primary_metric: pooled complex NMSE on the complete OOF train record; lower is better
selection.secondary_metric: pooled complex NMSE on the frozen 49-sample common interior; lower is better
selection.ranking_rule: minimize primary NMSE; candidates within 0.02 dB use secondary NMSE, then fewer real multiplications, fewer nonlinear operations, fewer stored coefficients, shorter L, smaller K, and lexical recipe name

evaluator_replacement.meaning: eligible for further independent PA-evaluator validation; does not itself open Gate A-to-B or permit reuse of the old APA test

cheap_pareto_retention.meaning: retain as a low-cost PA-model Pareto point only; do not call it the evaluator quality winner

required_quality: OpenDPD-compatible NMSE where complete frames exist
required_cost: real MUL and ADD per sample
fit time, iteration count and batch inference time
required_integrity: config, source, evidence and train/validation data hashes
exact selected model serialization and prediction hashes

follow_up.if_evaluator_replacement_eligible: freeze the recipe and obtain a new independent capture or verified APA_200MHz_b protocol before any new test claim; Gate A-to-B still needs the 10 dB margin and a second evaluator ranking
follow_up.if_only_cheap_pareto_retained: retain SPH as a hardware-cost baseline, but keep GMP as the evaluator; analyze SPH residual separability before considering sparse spline-memory
follow_up.if_neither: record the negative result and do not expand K or L outside the preregistered grid
follow_up.dpd_policy: DPD optimization remains paused until Gate A-to-B passes
